method: Phase boundaries follow Andrén et al. 2011 (plan §2) and are never averaged: where other authors differ the figure here stays Andrén's and the divergence is recorded in the data catalogue (0-07), not blended into a mean. Two times are not dated transitions and are cited to the chronology they sit inside rather than to a date: deglaciation.start at 20 000 cal BP is the window the visualisation opens on, and post-littorina.end at 0 is the present (1950). Event times are cross-sections positioned against the cited work, not independently published dates; the one that is a published date is billingen-after, inside the 11 620-11 700 cal BP range of the final drainage. The end of the Ancylus phase is given as 9 800 here; 9 500 appears in other works and the two are kept apart on purpose. Local onsets are separate from basin-wide boundaries because the transitions were not synchronous: the Littorina onset in the Little Belt is roughly a millennium younger than the basin-wide boundary, and comparing an event check against the wrong one of the two is how V-06 would fail for the wrong reason. The Little Belt position is the strait, not the borehole collar of IODP Site M0059, whose coordinates this repo does not record.
